verdict.rationale: Braintrust's docs explicitly position evals as a CI/CD step: run them on every pull request, integrate experiments into CI/CD to catch regressions before production, and run them headlessly with `npx braintrust eval`. Its marketing also claims it can 'Block bad releases before they hit production.' The gating half rests mostly on that claim, with no documented pass/fail mechanics. Missing for 10: documented gating mechanics (score thresholds, non-zero exit codes, or an official CI action/integration example), and independent or hands-on corroboration of CI gating.

support.subject: As a developer, I can run evals in CI and gate deployments on their results
